content:
maria_sales: FYI — Brightway renewal is coming up Oct 1. They hit +3x usage this quarter after the POC. Need deal desk to review a retention offer.
nate_dealdesk: thanks — can you paste their current ratecard + committed monthly spend? cc @paul_fin for any pricing constraints.
maria_sales: current commit = $75k/mo, 12m term. Their actual monthly run is ~220k tokens/day -> est $110k/mo usage. They're asking for a 30% uplift cap for 6mo, plus POC credits to offset professional services.
sam_ae: re: POC credits — we promised a one-time $30k credit for onboarding in the Q2 SOW. I can confirm that was in the contract appendix.
lee_se: on the technical side they want dedicated inference for latency-sensitive endpoints, which bumps per-token unit price. We recommended a hybrid: keep hosted for non-critical and move 2 routes to dedicated.
jess_custsuc: customer is worried about invoice shock. They prefer a predictable commit they can budget to — proposing a stepped commit: 90k/mo for 3 months, 115k/mo for next 9, with usage overage at 10% discount.
paul_fin: stepping is doable but we need to model ARR and margin. Send me the blended unit economics and the expected uplift impact. If discounts >15% we'll need exec sign-off.
nate_dealdesk: upload the proposed numbers here and I'll route to approvals. Also need confirmation whether we can apply the $30k POC credit against the first invoice or amortize over term.
maria_sales: they want it applied up-front. I think amortizing would be fine if needed. Attaching a quick calc:
```
Current commit: $75,000/mo
Proposed step1: $90,000/mo (months 1-3)
Proposed step2: $115,000/mo (months 4-12)
One-time POC credit: $30,000
Expected monthly usage: ~$110k/mo
Overage policy: 10% discount on usage above commit
Estimated FY impact: +$480k ARR vs current
```
lee_se: quick note — if we enable KV caching and prefix reuse we can reduce tokens on two endpoints by ~20%, could justify a smaller uplift.
paul_fin: ok that calc looks reasonable. Nate, if we accept that stepping and a one-time credit applied across first 3 invoices, discount effective rate stays around 12% — within delegated authority.
nate_dealdesk: @legal_bot — any blockers on modifying renewal addendum to include the stepped commit and credit amortization? We need a fast turn.
legal_bot: Flag: need to confirm change to billing schedule and amend Appendix B. No privacy or compliance blockers. Suggested clause: "Customer shall receive a one-time credit of $30,000 to be applied across the first three invoices following renewal." I'll draft.
jess_custsuc: customer asked for a 30-day rollback clause if latency targets aren't met after migration. Can we include a performance SLX or PSP? (they want an easy out)
lee_se: we can include a 30-day remediation window with a defined SLA (p95 < 150ms) for the two dedicated routes. If not met, automatic rollback to hosted and credit for the impacted month.
paul_fin: that remediation plan looks fine, but any rollback has cost implications. Add a contingency line item in the SOW for rollback run costs.
maria_sales: good progress. Nate — can you route this for approval today? Customer is asking for final terms by EOD tomorrow.
nate_dealdesk: routing now to Deal Desk and Finance. If approved I'll post the updated addendum and send to legal for signature. :thumbsup:
sam_ae: I can join the final call if needed to negotiate the wording. Ping me when the redlines are ready.
maria_sales: thanks everyone — will update Brightway that we're in final approval and expect term sheet by EOD tomorrow. :pray:
